Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring technical engineering manager to redefine the embedded Linux experience with the smallest, most secure, and most reliable operating system in the IoT market.
This is an opportunity for a technical leader passionate about open source software, Linux, containers, security, and the developer experience, to shape the future of Linux from the smallest systems up to desktops. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill as well as high caliber for inspiring and driving people.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardize the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an engineering manager, you'll lead a team of strong software developers to design and implement Ubuntu Core system software on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will meet stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan the roadmap and ensure the team can deliver their goals. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The role entails

  • Building and leading a distributed team of engineers through hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback and career development
  • Demonstrating sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Coaching and mentoring team members with hands‑on career development
  • Effectively setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocating and advancing modern, agile software development practices and helping develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Contributing to a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Actively participating in the leadership team and collaborating with other leaders in the organisation

What we are looking for in you

  • Demonstrated competencies in embedded software development
  • Strong skills in Golang, C++ and Shell
  • A solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Love for developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • Demonstrated ability of planning and executing to deliver high quality software in a timely manner
  • Solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

Nice-to-have skills

  • Familiarity with an immutable Linux distribution, preferably Ubuntu Core
  • Experience with multiple CPU architectures such as ARM, RISC-V
  • Experience with Linux native containerization and security

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Estagiário(a) | Infraestrutura e Project Finance | RJ

Join to apply for the Estagiário(a) | Infraestrutura e Project Finance | RJ role at Cescon, Barrieu, Flesch & Barreto Advogados

Sobre nós

Atuamos de forma global e integrada em todas as áreas do direito, compreendendo o impacto de cada decisão jurídica no contexto mais amplo dos negócios. Antecipamos riscos, simplificamos a complexidade, combinando tecnologia, dados e inteligência. Seguimos fortalecendo relações de confiança e construindo estratégias jurídicas que impulsionam o crescimento sustentável dos nossos clientes. É assim que consolidamos o Cescon Barrieu como Centro de Inteligência Jurídica.

Nossa Cultura

  • Colaboração: Compartilhamos conhecimento, trabalhamos em equipe, agimos com empatia, mantemos uma comunicação ativa e transparente.
  • Protagonismo: Somos criativos, adaptáveis e proativos, tomamos a iniciativa e assumimos a responsabilidade.
  • Cliente no centro: Compreendemos o cliente, somos acessíveis e respondemos com agilidade.
  • Excelência: Atuamos em altos padrões de qualidade, somos meticulosos.

Queremos ser a sua escolha! Nossa equipe de Infraestrutura e Project Finance está buscando um(a) Estagiário(a) para atuar no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Sobre a área

Nossa área de Infraestrutura e Financiamento de Projetos é formada por profissionais versáteis e com uma expertise diferenciada. Nossa ampla gama de atuação e a experiência de nossos advogados nos dão uma visão única das questões e tendências regulatórias de setores e agências reguladoras brasileiras.

Nossa prática abrange desde o assessoramento a processos de licitação e apresentação de pleitos perante agências reguladoras, até a estruturação societária, contratual e financeira de projetos. Temos uma equipe dedicada à negociação de contratos de infraestrutura, como EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction), offtake e O&M (Operação e Manutenção) e também assessoramos clientes com reivindicações durante a fase de construção.

Financiamento de projetos de infraestrutura tem sido uma das nossas principais especialidades desde nossa fundação. Nossa equipe atuou em operações pioneiras, como, por exemplo, o primeiro project finance internacional limited‑recourse para projeto greenfield, o primeiro project finance non‑recourse para produção de petróleo, o primeiro project bond internacional e o primeiro bond internacional lastreado em royalties de petróleo.

Entre nossos clientes estão as maiores instituições financeiras mundiais, bancos de desenvolvimento, agências multilaterais, agências de crédito à exportação (ECAs) e fundos de investimento, bem como os empreendedores, sponsors, offtakers e construtoras mais ativas e atuantes nesse mercado.

Valorizamos a diversidade e incentivamos a candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Participar de auditorias jurídicas;
  • Acompanhar as operações de financiamento de projeto de infraestrutura e negociações de contratos (com foco nos setores de Energia e O&G);
  • Elaborar pesquisas e materiais para o setor de infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar na análise de legislações e regulamentos da CVM, ANBIMA, B3 e Banco Central;
  • Participar de reuniões e operações de relevância nacional e internacional.

Requisitos

  • Estar no 7º período da graduação em Direito;
  • Ter interesse em Direito Civil, Administrativo ou Empresarial;
  • Boa comunicação e redação jurídica;

O Líder de Operações será responsável por liderar a equipe de operadores de equipamentos e auxiliares de rampa, atuando com assertividade na gestão de pessoas e processos operacionais para promover o desenvolvimento do grupo e do setor, além de garantir a conformidade da equipe às normas, políticas e procedimentos do departamento e da empresa.

Nos aspectos sensoriais, é necessária acuidade visual para condução de veículos, suporte à equipe e acompanhamento operacional, além de percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico, comunicação com colaboradores e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos, exige-se atenção, concentração, habilidades organizacionais, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa na resolução de situações.

title: WordPress Software Engineer
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore enables digital publishers to build sustainable businesses by maximizing their advertising revenue with privacy‑first, cutting‑edge ad tech. We are a fully remote, globally distributed team that values ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

The Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer (WordPress) with strong PHP and WordPress experience to help us build, scale, and maintain high‑performance publisher sites and WordPress‑based products that integrate with our ad tech stack. You’ll collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to ship features end‑to‑end in an agile, asynchronous environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom WordPress plugins and themes using modern PHP.
  • Build REST APIs and integrations with internal services and third‑party platforms (analytics, ad tech, SSO, etc.).
  • Optimize performance (Core Web Vitals), security, and reliability across high‑traffic sites.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and code quality tooling.
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues; participate in an on‑call rotation (reasonable schedule, follow‑the‑sun).
  • Partner with stakeholders to estimate effort, break down work, and deliver iterative value.
  • Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

You’ll Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy owning features from design to deployment.
  • Communicate clearly in an async, remote‑first culture (Slack, docs, PRs).
  • Care about developer experience, code quality, and maintainability.

Qualifications

Must‑Haves

  • 2–3 years professional experience building WordPress sites, plugins, or products.
  • Solid PHP (7.x/8.x) fundamentals and familiarity with modern patterns (OOP, namespaces, Composer, PSR standards).
  • Strong WordPress expertise: hooks/filters, custom post types, WP‑CLI, multisite, Gutenberg/Block Editor.
  • Frontend proficiency: HTML5, CSS/Sass, JavaScript/TypeScript, React for Gutenberg blocks.
  • Experience with MySQL/MariaDB, query optimization, and caching (Object Cache/Redis, page caching).
  • Git/GitHub (PR reviews, trunk‑based or GitFlow), CI/CD fundamentals.
  • Performance and security best practices (Core Web Vitals, CWEs/OWASP, nonces/capabilities).
  • Comfortable working across time zones in a remote team.

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Experience with ad tech (Google Ad Manager, Prebid, header bidding) or analytics (GA4, Looker Studio).
  • Infrastructure experience: Docker, Nginx/Apache, Varnish, Cloudflare, AWS/GCP.
  • Automated testing in the WP/PHP ecosystem (PHPUnit, Pest, Playwright, Cypress).
  • Familiarity with SEO, internationalization (i18n/l10n), and accessibility (WCAG).
  • Experience with telemetry/observability (Logrocket/Sentry, OpenTelemetry, Datadog/New Relic).

Example Projects You Might Own

  • Build a privacy‑aware custom plugin that injects ad placements conditionally based on consent signals (TCF/US Privacy) and viewability.
  • Migrate legacy shortcodes to Gutenberg blocks with React and server‑side rendering for performance.
  • Implement an edge‑cache strategy and object caching to reduce TTFB and improve LCP across high‑traffic pages.
  • Create a small service that syncs WP content with internal APIs; expose a hardened REST endpoint for partners.

title: mbar Energia - Gerente de Manutenção (Usina Termelétrica)
description:
Job description

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Manutenção que ficará responsável pelo gerenciamento de toda equipe de manutenção mecânica, através do acompanhamento de cada etapa dos processos existentes, indicadores de desempenho dos colaboradores, compra dos devidos equipamentos a fim de disponibilizar e garantir uma operação funcional confiável em todos os equipamentos da usina.

#LI-Onsite

Main responsibilities

  • Elaborar e gerenciar os planos de manutenção preditiva e preventiva, que por sua vez, é criado pelo departamento de Engenharia, através das necessidades e estratégias ao avaliar, corrigir e fornecer subsídios, para que o plano possa ser revisado e reciclado constantemente;
  • Assegurar que as atividades de manutenção sejam efetuadas de acordo com os mais rígidos padrões de segurança e criteriosos procedimentos ambientais e de acordo com as estratégias de manutenção preditiva e preventiva, criados pelo Departamento de Engenharia e as solicitações de manutenções corretivas e coordenação diárias, interagindo com os departamentos de Operações, manutenção mecânica, elétrica, instrumentação e civil em conjunto para execução de desenvolvimentos rumando a otimizações de resultados;
  • Assegurar para que os serviços de manutenção contratados nas áreas de civil, mecânica e elétrica sejam executados conforme escopo de serviço e dentro da dotação orçamentária através da supervisão e programação de atividades das empresas contratadas, a fim de obter satisfação do cliente;
  • Orientar, assegurar e desenvolver os profissionais técnicos do departamento acerca de qualifica-los para exercer as atividades de manutenção requeridas, através de identificação de deficiências a fim de criar programação de treinamentos específicos para as devidas reciclagens;
  • Obter melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, contribuindo na redução dos custos da manutenção;
  • Realizar entrevistas técnicas para contratação e feedback de profissionais da área de sua reponsabilidade, para a garantia de inserir a vaga em aberto, bem como criar estratégias para aperfeiçoamento da equipe e obtenção de resultados;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMAS da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMAS e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potencias impactos ambientais.

Requirements and skills

  • Superior em engenharia elétrica, eletrônica ou mecânica;
  • Desejável especialização na área técnica ou na área de gestão de qualidade ou administração;
  • Experiência em supervisão de função técnica na área de geração de energia ou industrial ou similar;
  • Conhecimento de Termodinâmica, Vibração, Técnicas Preditivas;
  • Curso de inglês técnico;
  • NR-10,e o SEP ( Sistema Elétrico Potência);
  • Conhecimento em Subestação de 6,6Kv, 13,8Kv e 138Kv;
  • Conhecimento em Elétrica Industrial;

  • Conhecimento em Mecânica Industrial;
  • Conhecimento em Automação Industrial;
  • Conhecimento em Caldeira HRSG;
  • Segurança do Trabalho em área Industrial;
  • Vivencia em Manutenção em Geradores de Energia, Turbina a Gás e Turbina a Vapor;

A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Missão:

Em colaboração com a Equipe de TI, Divisões de Negócios e Áreas Corporativas, o Corporate BRM (Business Relationship Manager) e Client Services Lead é o principal Parceiro de Negócios para as Áreas Corporativas e também responsável pela operação transversal de serviços ao cliente no Brasil. Ele/Ela será responsável por manter o engajamento e a comunicação com os stakeholders, compreender o negócio, auxiliar na priorização de projetos, garantindo que os projetos estejam alinhados com uma tecnologia que proporcione o máximo retorno sobre o investimento.

Principais Atividades:

  • Construir e gerenciar a equipe de relacionamento para garantir a convergência e a parceria estratégica com a equipe de parceiros de negócios, incluindo o trabalho próximo com a liderança de CxO como patrocinadores executivos para cada parceiro de negócios.
  • Fazer parceria com a organização de gerenciamento de projetos/programas/portfólio (PMO) para garantir um portfólio de iniciativas saudável e bem gerenciado.
  • Supervisionar o planejamento de projetos de aplicativos, execução, monitoramento de marcos, rastreamento e atualizações de status. Gerenciamento de orçamento e recursos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de funções de negócios e a posição mais apropriada para a adoção da função dentro da organização. Medir a adoção e trabalhar com a liderança Corporativa (Jurídico, RH, Sourcing, Comunicação) para desenvolver roteiros e oportunidades futuras.
  • Focar no valor de negócio em vez de soluções para desenvolver ideias, incluindo conscientização digital, avaliações de risco, continuidade de negócios e requisitos de capacidade de negócios.
  • Gerenciar as demandas internas dos clientes, atuando como mediador entre a satisfação do cliente e a viabilidade da TI (orçamento, limitações técnicas, prioridades, etc.).
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar processos de Gerenciamento de Serviços de TI, como gerenciamento de incidentes, problemas, mudanças e liberações, para alinhar-se aos objetivos de negócios. Eles supervisionam o desempenho e o alinhamento dos serviços de TI, garantem a conformidade com os padrões e SLAs, gerenciam os relacionamentos com os stakeholders e promovem uma cultura de melhoria contínua de serviços usando dados e análises.
  • Estratégia e Alinhamento de Serviços: Garantir que os serviços de TI se alinhem aos objetivos de negócios e às prioridades estratégicas, guiando a estratégia de TI e a alocação de recursos.
  • Monitoramento de Desempenho: Monitorar o desempenho dos serviços e da infraestrutura de TI para garantir que eles atinjam os objetivos, entregando o valor de negócio esperado.
  • Gerenciamento de Stakeholders: Atuar como um elo estratégico, gerenciando relacionamentos com stakeholders internos, clientes e parceiros externos.
  • Gerenciamento de Catálogo de Serviços: Estabelecer e manter um catálogo de serviços abrangente que defina claramente os serviços de TI disponíveis e seus SLAs associados.
  • Fazer parceria com a Equipe de Infraestrutura para garantir o melhor em Gerenciamento de Rede, Gerenciamento de Servidores, Operações de Armazenamento e Data Center, Gerenciamento de Hardware e Software, Monitoramento de Sistemas e Otimização de Desempenho, Gerenciamento de Configuração, Segurança e Continuidade de Negócios, Planejamento de Recuperação de Desastres.

Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Habilidades de liderança para guiar e treinar a equipe.
  • Experiência em Metodologia de Projetos (PMI, PMO).
  • Experiência com Gerenciamento de Orçamento e Fornecedores.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de Infraestrutura.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de serviços de TI.
  • Certificação ITIL.

Rio de Janeiro, BR

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável por ajudar equipes pedagógicas, alunos e famílias a utilizarem tecnologias de forma eficiente em suas aulas, bem como por gerenciar e manter os softwares pedagógicos da escola.

O que você fará:

  • Ajudar os professores a utilizar tecnologias educacionais, incluindo ferramentas de aprendizado online, software de gerenciamento de aulas e outras tecnologias;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e responder chamados de professores, famílias e alunos, resolvendo problemas relacionados aos software e tecnologia educacional de maneira rápida e eficiente;
  • Gerenciar e manter os sistemas tecnológicos da escola atualizados;
  • Capacitar professores e funcionários em novas tecnologias e ferramentas;
  • Participar ativamente dos eventos e rotinas pedagógicas da escola, com ideias de inovação ou complementação tecnológica.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Design, Pedagogia, Engenharia, TI ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês intermediário (conversação) e avançado (leitura);
  • Experiência com as ferramentas Google for Education (Classroom, Docs, Sheets, Slides, etc);
  • Vivência com atendimento presencial e atendimento de chamados;
  • Experiência com tecnologias educacionais e dispositivos como iPads, Sphero, etc;
  • Certificação de Educador Google Nível 1.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Certificação de Educador Google Nível 2 e Trainer, e semelhantes;
  • Conhecimento de Metodologias Ativas, Cultura Maker e Design Thinking;
  • Familiaridade com softwares de gerenciamento de dados, acervo e chamados (iSAMS, ServiceDesk+, AgendaEdu, Seesaw);
  • Experiência em escolas ou outros ambientes educacionais.

Você vai se encaixar bem se tiver:

  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com diferentes públicos (alunos, colaboradores administrativos, colaboradores pedagógicos);
  • Postura colaborativa voltada para solução de problemas;

Engenharia e Melhoria Contínua

title: Laboratory Technician
description:
Laboratory Technician

We’re unlocking community knowledge in a new way. Experts add insights directly into each article, started with the help of AI.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonisation and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

  • Production Superintendent

Background

The Laboratory Technician is responsible for ensuring the product specification is correct in terms of BS &W by sampling and analysis. They have a specific responsibility for ensuring chemical stocks and rates are maintained at appropriate levels and that sample reports are communicated effectively.

Authority

  • The Laboratory Technician has authority over subordinates.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Visitors, Chemical Vendors

Responsibilities & Standards

  • Carry out routine sampling and testing/analysis operations, including careful preparation and maintaining sample integrity.
  • Prepare for simple testing/analysis, conduct tests, and record results within appropriate documentation.
  • Maintain safe and healthy conditions in the working environment by complying with safety procedures, following incident and emergency protocols, and limiting damage to persons or property.
  • Ensure that laboratory and field test equipment is calibrated and maintained, including identifying calibration requirements, monitoring adherence, arranging calibration, and recording details.
  • Control stocks of equipment, materials and chemicals required for laboratory and plant: order stocks, receive and store stock (including bunkering of chemicals), optimise usage, and issue stock to ensure adequate levels for other users.
  • Communicate information (written and orally) accurately, concisely and promptly, processing incoming and outgoing communications, relaying oral and written messages, logs and providing information for specific purposes or tasks.
  • Monitor and maintain pollution control measures: identify unplanned discharges, halt where possible, report according to policy, use relevant PPE, dispose waste or other materials correctly, and enforce environmental protection and pollution control effectively.
  • Emergency response: carry out emergency response role (see Station Bill) and demonstrate competence in emergency response drills and exercises.

Functional Competencies

  • Offshore – Handover
  • Offshore – Sampling
  • Offshore – Safety Management
  • Offshore – Laboratory
  • Offshore – Communications
  • Offshore – Field Operations
  • Offshore – Stock monitoring – Chemicals
  • Offshore – Analysers

Qualifications & Experience

  • Qualification in Chemistry required.
  • Experience as a Lab Technician in the hydrocarbon processing industry (FPSO experience preferred).
  • Practical experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to the Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

General Information

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). description:
Join to apply for the Regional OTC Innovation Lead (Latam) role at Haleon

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose‑driven, world‑class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – leads in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy, which puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance‑focused culture.

Purpose of the role

As OTC Innovation Lead for LATAM , you will lead the development and execution of breakthrough strategies that bring new products to life across multiple markets. This is a high‑impact role where creativity meets business acumen, influencing cross‑functional teams and delivering growth for iconic brands.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver innovation plan for the defined BMCs (Colombia, Brazil, Mexico) based on a consumer‑centric approach
  • Maximise innovation into the rest of LATAM based on market range and innovation assessments with local teams (LEC, Colombia, Peru)
  • Ensure timely presentations of innovation projects through required BU governance
  • Partner with multifunctional teams to ensure proper progression of all innovation projects for on‑time and on‑full delivery against plans, ensuring alignment among all areas for flawless execution
  • Recommend, align, and drive business‑case assumptions by leveraging all business levers to maximise and scale up opportunities

Desired Capabilities

  • Consumer first, always: Engage key business counterparts and operational stakeholders to deliver operational execution of Haleon strategies related to eCommerce activities, always putting the consumer first
  • Collaborate for impact: Establish and maintain relationships with critical groups to ensure customer knowledge is utilised to inform and deliver on the eCommerce roadmap, collaborating for impact
  • Unlock value, at pace: Drive business process improvement throughout the commercial and operational support teams, unlocking value at pace
  • Grow myself and others: Continuously look for opportunities to learn, build skills, and share learning, growing myself and others

Code of Conduct for Leaders

  • Be the role model that brings our Code to life, by always acting with the highest ethical standards
  • Ensure your team, especially new members, are familiar with our Code and the Ethics & Compliance contact in your market
  • Maintain an environment of trust that allows all to Speak Up, reinforcing the guarantee of anonymity and non‑retaliation
  • Listen to your team and promptly raise any compliance concerns you become aware of
  • Make any necessary corrective and preventive decisions, in a timely manner
  • Recognise those in your team who display ethical behaviour; share examples of good ethical decision‑making, so all understand how we expect them to act
  • Provide timely support into any company investigation of potential wrongdoing

Equal Opportunities

Haleon is committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

Description and Requirements

We are Lenovo! We’re a leader in genuine innovation, dreaming up – and building – the technology and services that enable and inspire progress around the world. Our innovative high-quality PCs & Smart Devices, Data Centers, Mobile and Smart Office products are designed and built with the customer in mind. And it’s our people who make this all happen - we believe different is better and our strength lies in this diversity.

Lenovo is the Number 1 Supercomputing provider in the world measured by Top 500 entries, and we keep going. Our Data Center team is dedicated to fostering an environment that encourages entrepreneurism and ownership - a workplace where your talents can be challenged, and your efforts recognized and rewarded.

We are currently hiring for an HPC System Administrator to work onsite with one of our customers based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Responsibilities

As part of the Lenovo Managed Services team your responsibilities will include:

  • Monitoring, maintaining, and managing the physical infrastructure of a data center, ensuring its smooth operation, reliability, and security.
  • Monitoring power and cooling systems and network connectivity.
  • Hardware and system software debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Addressing hardware and software issues.
  • Responding to alerts, performing preventative maintenance, rolling out and upgrading firmware versions, and managing any issues that may arise to minimize downtime and optimize data availability.
  • Become the customers’ Single Point of Contact (SPOC).
  • Opening hardware trouble tickets against different vendors.
  • Following up and reporting the progress on all issues. Respond to users and provide support to them on the daily operations of the cluster.
  • Daily system administration tasks including granting and deleting access.
  • Investigate and correct hardware defects in the cluster as reported, adhering to the service levels.
  • Resolve errors through developing, testing and implementing changes to the system.
  • Provide corrective and preventive maintenance, troubleshoot and isolate defects.
  • Perform Software and firmware testing for any fixes, upgrades, security patch.
  • Update the customers’ documentation when and as necessary to reflect the changes made to the system.
  • Compile Monthly Reporting and take part in monthly customer Service Reviews where required.

Working directly with the customer you will be responsible for:

  • The installation, configuration, and the support of services as required within the central customer Research Computing Services platform team.
  • Work with vendors and customer Technology Office to design, implement and upgrade services using change management and revision.
  • Control processes to ensure that changes are properly tracked and available for audit when required.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot system issues, defining, and resolving complex issues.
  • Develop innovative solutions to continuously improve HPC and address any shortfalls in provision.
  • Work closely with other customer staff, including Infrastructure Technology, Security and Governance teams.
  • Understand the importance of security and seek specialist security advice to secure systems.
  • Maintain a knowledge of technical developments, tools, and ideas in HPC, attending seminars, conferences, technical briefings, and other community events.
  • Work flexibly as a part of the customer Platform Team, supporting the group’s activities and undertaking individual projects.
  • Write and maintain documentation on system design and management processes to ensure knowledge is accessible and disseminated appropriately within the customer team.
  • Deliver a high-quality service through a collaborative approach and outstanding analytical skills.
  • Take an active part in meetings, representing the customer, and facilitating collaboration between partners.
  • Assist customer researchers to utilize the HPC resource, providing subject matter expertise support to the Customer Research Computing Analysts.

The role gives you a great deal of independence and opportunity to take the lead and advise. You will be expected to work effectively in providing technical services in the areas of Server, Storage, Network, Power and Cooling, OS, and cluster management software.

The job responsibilities involve providing knowledge transfer, troubleshoot, resolve and advise on the mentioned infrastructure and technologies, continuously monitoring critical data center parameters.

The role includes incident management by quickly identifying and resolving issues raised by alerts, including hardware failures, network disruptions, and power fluctuations.

The position will require you to build a solid customer relationship, so it is important that you possess customer interaction skills and ability to make technical decisions, to collaborate during projects with several organization verticals, partners, and customers and to develop training and knowledge base documentation.

Position requirements

  • Experience in system troubleshooting, monitoring, and support.
  • Experience in System administration.
  • Experience in Hardware support, Hardware break-fix, Hardware replacements and installations.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese languages.
  • Able to perform OS installation and upgrades with no supervision.
  • Able to perform high level problem determination.
  • Customer service skills including written and oral communication with client.

Join to apply for the INSTRUMENTADOR CIRÚRGICO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar junto à equipe cirúrgica, se responsabilizando pela organização, quantidade e qualidade do funcionamento do instrumental e de equipamentos a serem utilizados pela equipe cirúrgica, estando atento a controle de reposição e devolução.

Join to apply for the MAQUEIRO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde .

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly innovative, data‑driven Email Marketing Manager, who’s motivated by the challenge of working with some of the fastest growing e‑commerce and digital brands.

You will join a team of email, SMS and retention marketing industry experts to drive client revenue, partner with internal cross‑functional colleagues to go deeper on understanding our customer needs and insights with a specific focus on deepening retention and building loyalty. You will lead a cross‑functional team to build creative strategies in email and SMS campaign development to help our clients grow.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Spain, Mexico, Portugal, and Brazil.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e‑commerce and digital marketing. You’re immersed in the world of direct‑to‑consumer growth marketing and love connecting strategy, creativity, and data to drive results.

  • 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands‑on retention experience.

  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.

  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.

  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.

  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.

  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life

  • Serve as the primary retention lead for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a bi‑weekly basis, you will lead meetings with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.

  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.

  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email, SMS, loyalty and subscription programs.

  • Project manage and delegate campaign briefs to your team, consisting of both retention specialists and designers.

  • Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client to ensure campaign quality and accuracy.

  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.

  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.

  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Growth, Digital, and Marketplaces teams to develop cohesive campaigns that drive client growth.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.

title: Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang
description:
Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world‑class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.

As an engineering manager you need both technical and management skills to lead your team. You will represent the team in direct partner engagement, ensuring stability and functionality that our cloud users expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU‑aided AI for servers, VMs, and containers.

As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring they grow as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. You will challenge and grow your team members with technical leadership and a solid background in software development. You will influence culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team builds. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high‑performing team.

Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands‑on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events

Qualifications

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Canonical by 2x.

RINA is currently recruiting for a HSE Advisor - Occupational Safety Technician to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the RINA Consulting QOHSE Division.

Mission

A Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Advisor typically plays a crucial role in supporting the HSE function within an organization. The role supports the application of the Corporate and Company policies, developing and implementing security policies, guidelines, procedures and protocols, for the security of Company assets, projects and business travels. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Compliance Monitoring:
- Ensure that the organization complies with local, state, and federal health and safety regulations.
- Monitor and track changes in regulations and update relevant stakeholders.
Risk Assessment:
- Assist in conducting risk assessments to identify potential hazards in the workplace.
- Collaborate with other departments to analyze and mitigate risks.
Training and Education:
- Support the development and delivery of HSE training programs for employees.
- Help create educational materials to promote awareness of health and safety issues.
Incident Investigation:
- Participate in investigations of accidents, incidents, or near-misses to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences.
- Assist in the documentation of incidents and the implementation of corrective actions.
Data Analysis:
- Collect and analyze HSE data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
- Prepare reports on HSE performance and make recommendations based on the analysis.
Emergency Response Planning:
- Contribute to the development and testing of emergency response plans.
- Assist in organizing drills and training exercises for emergency situations.
Inspections and Audits:
- Support regular inspections and audits to ensure compliance with HSE policies and procedures.
- Document findings and work with relevant teams to address any deficiencies.
Communication:
- Assist in the communication of HSE policies and procedures to employees.
- Participate in HSE meetings and collaborate with other departments to promote a culture of safety.
Documentation and Record Keeping:
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records related to HSE activities.
- Assist in preparing documentation for regulatory agencies and internal audits.
Continuous Improvement:
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in HSE processes and procedures.
- Stay informed about industry best practices and incorporate relevant updates into the HSE program.

  • Ability to analyze data and identify trends related to health, safety, and environmental performance.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Estágio em Administração e Suporte - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Estágio em Administração e Suporte - Rio de Janeiro

Você gostaria da oportunidade de estagiar em uma empresa Global de Energia e Tecnologia? Você gosta de embarcar em projetos desafiadores? Venha fazer parte do nosso Programa de Estágio! Previsão de Início: Março 2026 .

O nosso Estágio é pensado para permitir que estudantes de Nível Superior tenham a oportunidade de ter experiências práticas de trabalho formando uma base sólida para suas vidas profissionais. Nossos estágios lhe darão percepções de primeira mão sobre os processos, sistemas e práticas que estão alinhados para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas por meio de execução impecável e aplicação de tecnologia de ponta. Esteja ao lado dos melhores!

Nosso Estágio vai te proporcionar a oportunidade de participar em Treinamentos técnicos e de desenvolvimento, reuniões de equipe e participar de projetos para apresentar seus resultados! Durante seu estágio, você terá todo suporte da equipe, gestão e um Buddy designado especialmente para suas necessidades, garantindo que você tenha uma experiência de aprendizado valiosa.

Responsabilidades

  • Receber treinamento e mentoria, que permitirão que você complete suas tarefas e projetos que aperfeiçoarão seu aprendizado e habilidades;
  • Engajar, conhecer e aprender sobre sua área designada, mas não limitando‑se à;
  • Participar e entregar projetos internos para entregar resultados aos clientes (internos e externos) e identificar oportunidades de melhorias no negócio e área;
  • Aprender o Sistema Operacional interno (incluindo softwares e aplicativos) que te ajudarão no processo de desenvolver e entregar seus projetos e tarefas diárias;
  • Colaborar e conectar com diferentes times, estagiários e áreas da Baker Hughes para ter um amplo conhecimento e rede de networking global;
  • Aplicar os conceitos de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio‑Ambiente) garantindo e mantendo os procedimentos em todas as situações para um ambiente mais seguro, íntegro e saudável;
  • Participar e engajar em grupos de integração para estagiários e outros Hubs de voluntariado, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão que alavancarão seu networking e desenvolvimentos de habilidades por todo o Globo.

Qualificações

  • Estar regularmente matriculado em cursos de Engenharias de Produção, Administração, Economia;
  • Ter interesse e afinidade por áreas de rotinas administrativas e suporte;
  • Possuir Inglês de nível Intermediário para Avançado;
  • Ter disponibilidade para estagiar pelo período de 02 anos, 30h por semana;
  • Possuir o direito de estagiar legalmente no Brasil.

Informações sobre a área de atuação

Dentro da Baker Hughes temos diversas áreas de oportunidade para estagiar. Abaixo detalhamos as possíveis áreas de atuação na área de Administração e Suporte:

  • Administração : desenvolvimento, organização e controle de relatórios, planilhas e formulários, auxiliar no fluxo de comunicação para planejamento de atividades administrativas, operacionais e gestão de contratos; controle de compras locais para suprimento as demandas de facilities, Requisição de Compras/ Atualização e Controle de KPI do setor administrativo e gestão de contratos; controle de Treinamentos e Cursos; controle dos custos operacionais; controle de atendimento operacional.
  • Compras : participação em cotações com fornecedores, cadastro de fornecedores, entender relatórios de compras, fazer comparação de propostas comerciais, negociar condições de pagamento e atividades de analítica dentro de Sourcing.
  • Gestão de Contratos : suportar as atividades de análise dos contratos junto aos analistas de contrato de modo a agregar todas as alterações necessárias para entrega do projeto, incluindo consultas internas a outras áreas da empresa.
  • Treinamentos : organização e acompanhamento dos treinamentos, garantindo a atualização constante do conteúdo e a efetividade das atividades.
  • Logística de Pessoal : integração à equipe de Field Service, prestando suporte direto à logística de pessoal e indireto aos demais membros da equipe. Co‑responsável por controlar os treinamentos obrigatórios para a atividade offshore, atualização da matriz de competência, atualização de planilhas de controle, criação e lançamento de Work Order.
  • Facilities : gestão da manutenção predial, infraestruturas e coordenação de espaços, visando a segurança e bem‑estar de colaboradores, visitantes e fornecedores. Auxilia diretamente no gestor de facilities com todas as demandas e rotinas administrativas do departamento, controle de custos mensais, provisões de orçamento e autorização de pagamentos.

Localização: Diferentes escritórios espalhados entre as cidades do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Bahia. Confira a localização da vaga no momento da sua candidatura.

Formas de Trabalho: Disponibilidade para estagiar presencial ou no modelo híbrido; informe se não possui disponibilidade.

Faz mais com menos

A responsabilidade de uma comunicação eficaz é de todos. Entendemos o impacto de nossas decisões e nos comunicamos de maneira assertiva. Promovemos feedback e mantemos um diálogo honesto, transparente e responsável, com respeito e empatia.

Entregamos resultados com o time, seguindo nossos princípios com integridade, discernimento de prioridade e geramos valor. Enfrentamos a realidade - mesmo que desafiadora - e superamos as adversidades.
